environment.description: ARM Cortex-M4 based IoT gateway running FreeRTOS 10.4.3 with flat memory model (no MPU regions configured). MQTT broker accepts connections from any client with valid TLS certificate. Device uses software-emulated crypto library (mbedTLS) with keys stored in flash memory accessible to application code. No stack canaries (-fno-stack-protector). Firmware compiled with arm-none-eabi-gcc 9.3 without ASLR or DEP.
